name: Yong Kang Hotpot House
note: Open till 2am, mala broth strong enough to fix a bad day. Bring wet wipes.

name: Char Bar
note: Tiny, loud, and the bartender remembers your order after one visit.

name: 8 Seats
note: Omakase counter, only eight seats — book two weeks out or don't bother.

name: Local 42
note: Neighborhood joint, no menu in English, always something good happening on the stove.

name: Sunday Kitchen
note: Eggs till 3pm and a corner table that's basically mine now.

name: Trattoria Bassa
note: Candlelight and a wine list longer than the menu. Save for the second date.

name: Golden Dim Sum
note: Dim sum cart still does the rounds. Go hungry, go early, go on a Sunday.

name: The Backroom
note: Can't explain the menu, don't try. Just order the thing with the candle in it.

name: Old Wang's Noodles
note: Six stools, one wok, best noodles on the block. Cash only.
